subject: Implement core poker modules (cards, deck, hand evaluator)
description:
Create the foundational poker modules in /Users/huawang/pyproject/agentholdem/:

1. **agentholdem/card.py** - Card and Suit classes/enums. Card has rank (2-14, where 11=J,12=Q,13=K,14=A) and suit. String representation like "As", "Kh", "2c", "Td". 

2. **agentholdem/deck.py** - Standard 52-card deck with shuffle and deal methods.

3. **agentholdem/hand_eval.py** - Hand evaluator that determines the best 5-card hand from 7 cards (2 hole + 5 community). Must correctly rank: Royal Flush > Straight Flush > Four of a Kind > Full House > Flush > Straight > Three of a Kind > Two Pair > One Pair > High Card. Return a HandRank object that is comparable. Handle edge cases: A-2-3-4-5 straight (wheel), ace-high straight, kicker comparisons.

4. **agentholdem/__init__.py** - Package init.

Use Python 3.10+ with type hints. No external dependencies for core logic.
